title: confiture migrate validate --check-acls --format json
description: Static ACL coverage report: every `CREATE TABLE` in `--migrations-dir` must have a matching `GRANT` in the same migration or in the configured grant-sweep directory.

code.description: The rule code this is about.

reason.description: What was unavailable, and what that over-reports.

degraded.description: Rules that ran without one of the things they resolve against, so they can over-report (1.36.0). `acl_001` when the configured grant sweep directory (`migration.grant_dir`) does not exist: a table granted only there is reported as missing its grant. Always present, empty when none.

parser.description: What parsed the SQL behind this payload (0.50.0): the installed pglast release and the PostgreSQL grammar major it embeds.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. What the report found is in its own fields; a command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture` (`migrate up`, `lint`).
